usedFor: Reviews on Google Business Profile become deals through “Create Deal” in HubSpot, and HubSpot events can feed “Reply To Review”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Review Posted” in Google Business Profile, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new review opens a deal in HubSpot, so someone owns the follow-up instead of the review sitting unread.

watchOut: “New Review Posted” is polling, so a review reaches HubSpot on a schedule, not the moment it is posted.
